caption: sky note: "mercury in aquarius makes everyone emotionally unavailable." half true at best. mercury enters aquarius today.

slides.headline: “*mercury* in aquarius makes everyone emotionally unavailable”
“from today, nobody will text you back with feelings”
slides.body: astrologers do read mercury in aquarius as cooler, idea-first talk. that's a style, not a shutdown. the ones who never answered warmly weren't waiting on mercury.

slides.headline: mercury never strays *far* from the sun
slides.body: mercury always sits within about 28° of the sun. today it's in aquarius while the sun is still in capricorn.

slides.headline: clear head, *honest* words
slides.body: astrologers read it as good weather for saying what you think. feelings still count: name them, don't hint.

slides.headline: unavailable is a person, not a *planet*.
slides.body: the first thing you say should be true, not cute. that works in every sign.
